note: Adapted from the original English description by Harris (1966) (new species, type locality Karamoja, Uganda); the original describes neither the alate nor the worker. Measurements are translated verbatim from the table of the original, in millimetres; major soldier n=10, minor soldier n=8.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Major soldier with the head about as long as wide and conspicuously narrowed posteriorly, which distinguishes it from the other species of the genus; compared with A. latinotus the mandibles are stouter and more curved; compared with A. amphidon the tooth of the left mandible is blunter and the notch of the anterior margin of the pronotum is deeper and more angular. The minor soldier is markedly dimorphic relative to the major: head oval, the sides narrowed posteriorly, labrum conical, mandibles slender and tapering, only slightly curved at the apex. In its morphology the minor soldier is very close to A. cavithorax.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head yellow, setae inconspicuous; mandibles brown; antennae ivory; thorax, abdomen and legs ivory. Head about as long as wide, conspicuously narrowed posteriorly, the sides curved; labrum slightly longer than wide, bluntly pointed; mandibles stout, strongly incurved in the apical half, the inner margin of the left mandible with 1 small tooth at mid-length; postmentum (gulamentum) wide, narrowing anteriorly, strongly convex in cross-section; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 small, segments 4, 5 and 6 about equal in length. Pronotum with the anterior lobe small and pointed, an acute-angled notch between the lobes; posterior margin gently curved. Minor soldier: head pale yellow, mandibles pale brown; thorax and abdomen ivory. Head oval, the sides narrowed posteriorly; labrum conical; mandibles slender and tapering, slightly curved at the apex; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 very short; postmentum short and wide, convex in cross-section. Pronotum with the anterior lobe short, a shallow obtuse-angled median notch between the lobes. Measurements (mm; table of the original, the mean in parentheses): head length including mandibles, major soldier 1.68—1.82 (1.75), minor soldier 1.28—1.36 (1.32); head length 1.00—1.14 (1.10), 0.73—0.82 (0.75); head width 1.00—1.09 (1.04), 0.73—0.82 (0.77); left mandible length 0.76—0.82 (0.79), 0.59—0.68 (0.65); pronotum width 0.68—0.77 (0.73), 0.54—0.59 (0.56); hind tibia length 0.95—1.09 (1.02), 0.77—0.91 (0.85).
